title: How can Occupational therapy help me better understand my child’s behaviours?
metaTitle: Understanding Child Behaviors with Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network helps parents understand their child's behaviors by explaining sensory, cognitive, and social aspects. Gain insights into your child's perceptions and reactions.
html: Occupational therapists provide insights into why a child might be behaving a certain way. They explain the sensory, cognitive, and social aspects of the behaviour, helping parents understand their child's perceptions and reactions.
